headline: 2 buses targeted in arson attacks across Dhaka in single night
summary: A Shohag Paribahan bus was torched at Mohakhali terminal, while another was targeted in Mirpur, raising security concerns in the capital.
details: A Shohag Paribahan bus parked at Dhaka's Mohakhali bus terminal caught fire shortly before 1am on Sunday.
Two units from the Tejgaon Fire Station were dispatched to the scene after the Fire Service and Civil Defence received the report at 12:57am.
This was the second such incident in the capital in a single night. Earlier on Saturday night, a Bihanga Paribahan bus was targeted in Mirpur around 10pm.
According to police, attackers on a motorcycle poured petrol through a window onto the rear section of the parked Mirpur bus and set it alight.
Bus staff managed to extinguish the flames in the Mirpur incident, preventing total destruction, though several rear seats were damaged.

headline_marked: 14 arrested as [[fresh clash erupts at New Gini Properties]] in Dhaka
headline: 14 arrested as fresh clash erupts at New Gini Properties in Dhaka
summary: Police detained 14 people after 100-150 armed individuals stormed the housing project in South Manikdi on Saturday.
details: Police have arrested 14 people following a fresh brawl at the New Gini Properties housing project in Dhaka’s South Manikdi on Saturday afternoon.
According to the Dhaka Metropolitan Police (DMP), between 100 and 150 people armed with local weapons entered the project area and engaged in a fight.
Three of the arrested individuals were seriously injured and were transferred from Kurmitola Multicare Specialized Hospital to Dhaka Medical College Hospital for advanced treatment.
Cantonment police intervened to bring the situation under control and detained the suspects.
This is the second such incident at the site; the project was previously attacked, vandalized, and looted on September 26 over a similar land dispute.
The previous attack also hit the 'Brownfish' studio of content creator Salman Muqtadir, which is based within the project.
A case was filed at the Cantonment Police Station by Saiful Islam Bhuiyan, director of New Gini Properties, naming 13 people, including retired major general Golam Mohiuddin Chowdhury.
Eleven people have already been arrested in connection with the first attack, with eight of them currently out on bail.
caption:
100-150 armed individuals storm a Dhaka housing project. 14 arrested after a fresh clash.

Police have arrested 14 people following a fresh brawl at the New Gini Properties housing project in Dhaka’s South Manikdi on Saturday afternoon.

According to the Dhaka Metropolitan Police (DMP), between 100 and 150 people armed with local weapons entered the project area and engaged in a fight.

Three of the arrested individuals were seriously injured and were transferred from Kurmitola Multicare Specialized Hospital to Dhaka Medical College Hospital for advanced treatment.

Cantonment police intervened to bring the situation under control and detained the suspects.

This is the second such incident at the site; the project was previously attacked, vandalized, and looted on September 26 over a similar land dispute.

The previous attack also hit the 'Brownfish' studio of content creator Salman Muqtadir, which is based within the project.

A case was filed at the Cantonment Police Station by Saiful Islam Bhuiyan, director of New Gini Properties, naming 13 people, including retired major general Golam Mohiuddin Chowdhury.

Eleven people have already been arrested in connection with the first attack, with eight of them currently out on bail.
